entries.brief: Create ONE original square painterly fantasy encyclopedia bestiary icon for SKAZ, D&D 2014. A monstrous burrowing insect, rust-brown segmented chitin, triangular armored insect head, two huge curved crushing mandibles, short antennae and powerful folded digging forelimbs; a tiny bead of amber acid at a mandible. Upper body portrait, no dirt. Broad sculpted brush shapes, clear compact silhouette readable at 32px, moderate detail, warm upper-left light. Restrained natural materials. Entire silhouette occupies central 76 percent of square, every antenna and tip inside frame with generous clear padding. Dark defined outer edges and local light highlights readable on ivory and charcoal backgrounds. TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
